purpose: Rationale for MAX_REPETITIONS=2048; projections are estimates, not measured scored outcomes.

conservative_rates_from_first_diagnostic.method: maximum observed total_ns / repetitions among the six durable calibration attempts; linear projection only

assumptions_and_limits: A repetition is one complete sweep of all 2400 frozen inputs on one backend; a paired sample contains one native and one interpreter sweep set.
The projection uses the highest per-repetition rate observed in the first diagnostic attempts and assumes linear scaling through 2048 repetitions.
The 2048 cap is a reserve doubling after the first projected passing candidate 1024; the cap2048 calibration actually passed at 1024, so no 2048-repetition calibration or sample was measured.
Estimated duration excludes preflight/setup, outcome validation, journaling, host metadata, report writing, and teardown. It does not guarantee completion under 30 minutes.

The earlier monitoring records Stage2 compilation during release build, but no per-attempt timestamps establish whether Stage2 activity overlapped calibration totals; performance impact is unquantified.
No scored samples or performance comparison are contained in these artifacts.
